displayOrder.name: Focus Session
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality macOS desktop app screen for PokeTaskBar's Focus page, continuing the approved Today design.
Target: 1488 x 1056, matching the first reference's landscape aspect. Current date: Friday, 18 September 2026. One complete straight-on app window, readable SF Pro-like typography, generous whitespace, no surrounding presentation text.
References: image 1 is the approved Today shell and visual system; image 2 is the approved menu-bar focus controls and companion. Use their actual attached imagery. Translate Focus into the LIGHT main window. Preserve expanded left navigation exactly: PokeTaskBar, Cody, Search, Today, Focus, Issues, Projects, Initiatives, Collection, Usage; Settings at bottom. Focus is selected. Retain native traffic lights, page tab, sidebar-collapse controls. Both sidebars are resizable/collapsible.
IMPORTANT latest correction: absolutely no permanent sidebar separator strokes, vertical rules, full-width horizontal rules, or resize grip dots. At rest the boundary guides are invisible. Show resting state with no pointer. Separate areas using gutters and inset rounded surfaces, as in Linear. The left sidebar sits directly on continuous #EFF0F2 window shell; main #F8F8FA canvas has visibly inset rounded corners including the bottom. Discrete #FFFFFF right extras use rounded panels. Ink #242528, metadata #73757B, restrained blue accents and thin local control outlines. Do not box every item or add ornamental dashboards, analytics, extra nav items, rewards, streaks, or task queues. One active task is the primary use case; Pokémon supports it.
Content: Focus; SPA-142; Refine PokeTaskBar navigation; In progress; PokeTaskBar. Timer 24:18, caption remaining of 50 minutes, slim progress about halfway. Primary dark button Mark done, secondary Pause. Small tertiary +5 min and Reset controls. One small Session note action or composer (explicit Post note to Linear if a send button is shown). Small pixel-art Lapras companion consistent with references. No guilt-inducing copy. Keep all text crisp, buttons readable, no clipped content.

Direction name: Focus Session.
Layout: open and timer-led. Left nav 240px, generous 880px central inset canvas, optional 280px right extras. Main top has small Focus heading and short task context. In the main canvas center, place active issue identifier and a balanced two-line task title above a dominant 100px 24:18 timer; duration and progress underneath. Actions centered directly below, with +5 min and Reset as quiet tertiary controls. A single modest Session note row near the bottom of the main canvas. Right extras: one small companion panel with Lapras around 105px and 'Your focus companion'; below, one concise session-details group with status In progress, planned 50 min, next check-in 10:00. These are separate quiet groups, not KPI tiles. The central timer has ample breathing room and is clearly dominant; Lapras remains secondary. All areas float in the neutral shell with no edge dividers. A calm, precise native application, close to the attached light Linear-like Today mockup.

Main content starts at the upper-left with SPA-142 and the large task title Refine PokeTaskBar navigation, status In progress and project PokeTaskBar. Below that, a compact white horizontal timer module around 110px tall: 24:18 on left, remaining of 50 minutes in small type; Pause and dark Mark done buttons on right, quiet +5 min and Reset beneath. The slim progress line lives inside this module.
Below the timer, a spacious task brief in plain typography directly on the main surface, labelled 'Task context' with short prose: 'Refine the main navigation and keep page changes clear.' Then a clean low-height 'Session note' composer containing 'Keep the sidebar widths consistent between pages.' with explicit 'Post note to Linear'. This is a draft, not posted status.
Right sidebar has one small 'Session details' panel listing Planned duration 50 min and Check-in Every 10 min. Below that, an unboxed small Lapras sprite with 'Your focus companion'. Strong quiet reading hierarchy and lots of free space. Do not add checklist features or additional widgets. Inside the main canvas: small Focus page header at upper left; a quiet 'Session running' green dot at upper right. Place one active-task summary across the upper content area: small SPA-142 above title Refine PokeTaskBar navigation and the understated In progress / PokeTaskBar metadata. Below it, use a very spacious, unboxed two-column composition directly on the same canvas: left half holds a beautiful large 24:18 timer, remaining of 50 minutes, a slim progress track, Pause + dark Mark done buttons, and small +5 min / Reset controls. Right half holds a medium-small pixel-art Lapras companion around 170px tall, Lapras and 'Your focus companion'. The TIMER is visually dominant, companion secondary. No dividing stroke between these areas; empty space does the separation. Do not add a card around either column.
A single low-height white rounded note strip near the bottom is the only supporting surface, labelled 'Session note' and a quiet 'Add note' action. Keep huge purposeful whitespace and excellent balance with a wide canvas. No optional details, usage charts, logs, or future task cards in this collapsed state. No permanent separator lines or resize grip dots anywhere. Render a single composed actual product screen, not an annotated concept board.
